data.text: Now I'll run the SQL query to find the category with the highest average item price among categories with at least 50 items sold:

args.purpose: Find category with highest average item price among categories with at least 50 items sold
args.sql:
WITH category_stats AS (
    SELECT 
        ct.product_category_name_english,
        COUNT(*) as items_sold,
        AVG(oi.price) as avg_item_price,
        SUM(oi.price) as total_revenue
    FROM order_items oi
    JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
    JOIN category_translation ct ON p.product_category_name = ct.product_category_name
    JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
    WHERE o.order_status != 'canceled' AND o.order_status != 'unavailable'
    GROUP BY ct.product_category_name_english
    HAVING COUNT(*) >= 50
)
SELECT 
    product_category_name_english,
    items_sold,
    ROUND(avg_item_price, 2) as avg_item_price,
    total_revenue
FROM category_stats
ORDER BY avg_item_price DESC
LIMIT 10
